last.verdict: Record registrations and raised guidance, but shares slipped after a strong run.

reasons.label: Registrations spike before price hike
reasons.text: New registrations hit a record 13.1 million, just ahead of a November .com price increase.

reasons.label: Renewal rate slipping
reasons.text: Expected renewal rate fell to 74.3% from 75.4% a year earlier.

reasons.label: Guidance raised again
reasons.text: 2026 domain base growth outlook lifted to 6.5%-7.0%; revenue seen at $1.755-1.760 billion.

story: Verisign has raised domain-growth guidance each quarter this year, from 3.1%-4.3% in April to 6.5%-7.0% now, on record sign-ups. Shares rose about 7% after both the April and July reports; this time they slipped.
